rounds.text: Despite stellar headline returns, Hindustan Zinc Ltd trades at a rich valuation of 11.25x price-to-book on a book value of ₹ 53.6 [E2], carrying a valuation blind-spot where the price already discounts the good news [E61]. Institutional money flow signals caution with negative money flow and a holding change of -0.07 percentage points [E35], while promoter holdings have declined by 4.21 percentage points over recent periods [E32]. Operational risks and external headwinds persist, highlighted by hedge losses of ₹ 200 crores during the quarter [E86], an annualised volatility reading of 1202.8% [E45], and a low Sharpe ratio of 0.22 [E46]. Furthermore, capital-intensive expansion plans are underway, with capital-work-in-progress up 30.8% to ₹ 3,409 Cr [E31] alongside a hefty growth capex guidance of USD500 million to USD600 million [E70], which could strain future free cash generation if commodity cycles shift. Conceded: the company maintains a strong return on equity track record with a median of 69% over 3 years [E19] and robust operating cash flows of ₹ 17,008 Cr in Mar 2026 [E26].
